title: Cluster Topology Inspection
objective: Inspect cluster nodes and core components to understand architecture.
objectiveMm: Cluster architecture ကို နားလည်ရန် nodes နှင့် core components များကို စစ်ဆေးလေ့လာခြင်း။
prerequisites: ["Access to a running Kubernetes cluster","kubectl configured"]
environmentSetup: Use kind/minikube or a kubeadm lab cluster with at least 1 control-plane and 1 worker node.
steps: ["Run `kubectl cluster-info` and note control plane endpoint.","Run `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and identify roles, versions, internal IPs.","Run `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` and list control plane/system components."]
commands: ["kubectl cluster-info","kubectl get nodes -o wide","kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide"]
expectedOutput: Node list shows Ready nodes and kube-system shows core components such as kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, coredns, kube-proxy/CNI pods (varies by setup).
troubleshooting: ["If kubectl cannot connect, verify kubeconfig context and API server endpoint.","If nodes are NotReady, describe nodes and inspect conditions/events."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can identify control plane vs worker nodes.","I can name key control plane components running in the cluster."]

title: Control Plane Component Inspection
objective: Locate and inspect control plane component manifests and logs.
objectiveMm: Control plane component manifests/logs များကို ရှာဖွေစစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
prerequisites: ["kubeadm-based lab cluster recommended","Node shell access (for static manifests/logs)"]
environmentSetup: Use a control-plane node where static pod manifests are under /etc/kubernetes/manifests.
steps: ["List files in `/etc/kubernetes/manifests` and identify component manifests.","Describe kube-apiserver/scheduler/controller-manager pods in kube-system.","Review recent logs for one control plane component and note key flags/config references."]
commands: ["ls /etc/kubernetes/manifests","kubectl get pods -n kube-system","kubectl describe pod kube-apiserver-<node> -n kube-system","kubectl logs kube-scheduler-<node> -n kube-system --tail=50"]
expectedOutput: Static pod manifests and corresponding pods are visible; logs show component startup/runtime messages.
troubleshooting: ["Component pod name includes node name in kubeadm clusters.","If logs unavailable, check container runtime logs on the node."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can locate static pod manifests.","I can inspect status/logs of control plane components."]

title: Worker Node and kubelet Health Check
objective: Inspect node conditions and kubelet health.
objectiveMm: Node conditions နှင့် kubelet health ကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
prerequisites: ["Cluster access","SSH/node access for kubelet checks (optional but recommended)"]
environmentSetup: A cluster with at least one worker node.
steps: ["Run `kubectl describe node <worker>` and review Conditions, Capacity, Allocatable, and taints.","Check kubelet service status/logs on the node if accessible.","Correlate node conditions with cluster events."]
commands: ["kubectl get nodes","kubectl describe node <worker>","systemctl status kubelet","journalctl -u kubelet --no-pager -n 100","kubectl get events -A --sort-by=.lastTimestamp"]
expectedOutput: Node shows Ready condition when healthy; kubelet logs/status provide runtime details.
troubleshooting: ["NotReady may indicate kubelet, runtime, or network issues.","Check certificate expiration and config file paths if kubelet fails to start."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can interpret node conditions.","I know where to inspect kubelet status/logs."]

title: kubeadm Workflow and Node Maintenance
objective: Practice kubeadm lifecycle concepts and safe node maintenance operations.
objectiveMm: kubeadm lifecycle concepts နှင့် node maintenance လုပ်ငန်းစဉ်များကို လေ့ကျင့်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Use a disposable cluster (kind/kubeadm lab) where node drain/uncordon is safe.
steps: ["Review `kubeadm token create --print-join-command` output (or documented example).","Cordon and drain a worker node while preserving workload availability.","Uncordon the node and verify scheduling resumes.","Review `kubeadm upgrade plan` output in an upgrade-capable environment (or study output format)."]
commands: ["kubeadm token create --print-join-command","kubectl cordon <node>","kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data","kubectl uncordon <node>","kubeadm upgrade plan"]
expectedOutput: Node becomes SchedulingDisabled after cordon; pods evicted/rescheduled during drain (where possible); node schedulable after uncordon.
troubleshooting: ["Drain may fail due to PodDisruptionBudgets or standalone pods; use flags carefully in labs.","DaemonSets require --ignore-daemonsets."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can safely drain and uncordon a node.","I understand join/upgrade command purposes."]

title: HA Control Plane Concepts Verification
objective: Identify HA control plane components and failure considerations.
objectiveMm: HA control plane components နှင့် failure considerations များကို ဖော်ထုတ်နားလည်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: If available, use a multi-control-plane cluster; otherwise analyze architecture/docs.
steps: ["List nodes and identify multiple control-plane nodes if present.","Inspect kube-system lease/endpoints objects related to leader election.","Document how API server load balancing and etcd quorum affect availability."]
commands: ["kubectl get nodes -o wide","kubectl get leases -n kube-system","kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide"]
expectedOutput: Understanding of HA topology, leader election resources, and quorum requirements.
troubleshooting: ["Single-node labs cannot fully demonstrate HA failover; use documentation to supplement."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can explain API load balancer and etcd quorum roles.","I can identify leader election indicators in kube-system."]

title: RBAC Role and Binding Practice
objective: Create and verify namespace-scoped RBAC permissions.
objectiveMm: Namespace-scoped RBAC permissions များကို ဖန်တီးပြီး စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any Kubernetes cluster; create a temporary namespace `rbac-lab`.
steps: ["Create namespace and a ServiceAccount.","Create a Role allowing get/list/watch on pods.","Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount with a RoleBinding.","Verify allowed/denied actions using `kubectl auth can-i`."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"rbac-lab.yaml","content":"apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: rbac-lab
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: pod-reader-sa
  namespace: rbac-lab
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: rbac-lab
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: read-pods-binding
  namespace: rbac-lab
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: pod-reader-sa
  namespace: rbac-lab
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
"}]
commands: ["kubectl apply -f rbac-lab.yaml","kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:rbac-lab:pod-reader-sa -n rbac-lab","kubectl auth can-i delete pods --as=system:serviceaccount:rbac-lab:pod-reader-sa -n rbac-lab"]
expectedOutput: ServiceAccount can list/get/watch pods in rbac-lab but cannot delete pods.
troubleshooting: ["Ensure namespace matches in Role, RoleBinding, and can-i checks.","Use correct subject kind/name for users vs service accounts."]
verificationChecklist: ["Role and RoleBinding created successfully.","Allowed and denied permissions verified."]

title: etcd Snapshot Backup and Status Check
objective: Take an etcd snapshot and inspect it (restore steps reviewed in lab notes).
objectiveMm: etcd snapshot backup ယူခြင်းနှင့် စစ်ဆေးခြင်း (restore အဆင့်များကိုလည်း လေ့လာခြင်း)။
prerequisites: ["Access to etcd endpoint/certs (kubeadm control plane)","etcdctl installed"]
environmentSetup: Run on a control-plane node or environment with etcd client certs.
steps: ["Set ETCDCTL_API=3 and identify endpoint/cert paths.","Run snapshot save to a file in /tmp.","Run snapshot status to verify snapshot integrity metadata.","Review restore command and required manifest/data-dir updates (perform only in disposable lab)."]
commands: ["sudo ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key snapshot save /tmp/etcd-snapshot.db","sudo ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot status /tmp/etcd-snapshot.db --write-out=table"]
expectedOutput: Snapshot file created and status table displayed.
troubleshooting: ["Wrong cert/key/endpoint causes connection/auth errors.","Restore in production-like clusters requires careful static pod and data-dir handling."]
verificationChecklist: ["Snapshot save command succeeds.","I can explain restore prerequisites and risks."]

title: Helm Release and Kustomize Overlay Basics
objective: Perform basic Helm and Kustomize operations.
objectiveMm: Helm နှင့် Kustomize ၏ အခြေခံ လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်များကို လေ့ကျင့်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: A test namespace and internet access for chart repos (or pre-downloaded charts).
steps: ["Add a chart repo, install a release, then list releases.","Upgrade the release with changed values and verify rollout/resources.","Create/apply a simple Kustomize overlay that changes replicas or labels."]

expectedOutput: Helm release installed/upgraded successfully; Kustomize renders/applies modified manifests.
troubleshooting: ["Chart values/schema differ by chart version; inspect with `helm show values`.","Kustomize paths must be correct relative to kustomization.yaml."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can manage a Helm release lifecycle.","I can preview and apply a Kustomize overlay."]

title: CRD and Extension Interface Discovery
objective: Discover CRDs and identify CNI/CSI/CRI-related components.
objectiveMm: CRDs များနှင့် CNI/CSI/CRI ဆိုင်ရာ components များကို ရှာဖွေဖော်ထုတ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any Kubernetes cluster (some CRDs may already exist).
steps: ["List CRDs and describe one CRD schema/resource.","List API resources and find custom resources if present.","Inspect kube-system and relevant namespaces for CNI/CSI/runtime-related pods."]

expectedOutput: CRDs/API resources and extension-related components are identified.

verificationChecklist: ["I can inspect CRDs/custom resources.","I can identify extension interface components in a cluster."]

title: Deployment Rollout and Rollback
objective: Create, scale, update, and rollback a Deployment.
objectiveMm: Deployment ကို create/scale/update/rollback လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Test namespace.
steps: ["Create a Deployment with nginx image.","Scale replicas and verify Pods.","Update image to trigger rollout, then rollback to previous revision."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"web-deploy.yaml","content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
"}]
commands: ["kubectl apply -f web-deploy.yaml","kubectl scale deployment web --replicas=3","kubectl set image deployment/web nginx=nginx:1.26","kubectl rollout status deployment/web","kubectl rollout undo deployment/web"]
expectedOutput: Deployment scales and rolls out/rolls back successfully.
troubleshooting: ["If rollout stuck, check `kubectl describe deployment/web` and pod events.","Image tag typos cause ImagePullBackOff."]
verificationChecklist: ["Replicas scaled correctly.","Rollback restored previous revision."]

title: Jobs and CronJobs Practice
objective: Create and inspect Job and CronJob workloads.
objectiveMm: Job နှင့် CronJob workloads များကို ဖန်တီးစစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Any cluster with batch/v1 support.
steps: ["Create a one-off Job and wait for completion.","Create a CronJob with a short schedule in a lab environment.","Inspect created Jobs/Pods and logs."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"cronjob.yaml","content":"apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
          - name: hello
            image: busybox:1.36
            command: ["sh", "-c", "date; echo hello"]
"}]
commands: ["kubectl create job once --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh -c 'echo done'","kubectl get jobs,pods","kubectl apply -f cronjob.yaml","kubectl get cronjobs,jobs"]
expectedOutput: Job completes; CronJob creates Jobs on schedule.
troubleshooting: ["CronJob timing depends on controller manager and cluster time.","Check pod logs for command output."]
verificationChecklist: ["Job completed successfully.","CronJob generated at least one Job (or configuration validated)."]

title: ConfigMap, Secret, Probe, and Resources
objective: Configure an app Pod with external config, probe, and resource settings.
objectiveMm: ConfigMap/Secret, probe နှင့် resources များဖြင့် Pod ကို ပြင်ဆင်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Test namespace.
steps: ["Create ConfigMap and Secret.","Deploy a Pod/Deployment consuming them via env/envFrom or volumes.","Add readiness probe and resource requests/limits; verify Pod status."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"config-probe.yaml","content":"apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  APP_MODE: demo
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-secret
type: Opaque
stringData:
  PASSWORD: example
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app-config-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx:1.27
    envFrom:
    - configMapRef:
        name: app-config
    env:
    - name: PASSWORD
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: app-secret
          key: PASSWORD
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 64Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 200m
        memory: 128Mi
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 3
      periodSeconds: 5
"}]
commands: ["kubectl apply -f config-probe.yaml","kubectl get pod app-config-pod","kubectl describe pod app-config-pod","kubectl exec app-config-pod -- printenv APP_MODE"]
expectedOutput: Pod becomes Ready; env vars from ConfigMap/Secret available.
troubleshooting: ["Probe failures keep Pod NotReady; check container port/path.","Secret key names must match exactly."]
verificationChecklist: ["Config and secret injected correctly.","Probe and resources visible in Pod spec/status."]

title: Taints, Tolerations, and Node Affinity
objective: Control Pod placement with scheduling primitives.
objectiveMm: Scheduling primitives များဖြင့် Pod placement ကို ထိန်းချုပ်ခြင်း။
prerequisites: ["Cluster with at least one schedulable node"]
environmentSetup: Use labels/taints on a test node; clean up after lab.
steps: ["Label a node and create a Pod with node affinity/selector.","Apply a taint to the node and observe scheduling behavior.","Add a matching toleration and confirm Pod can schedule."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"toleration-pod.yaml","content":"apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: tolerate-pod
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "dedicated"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "lab"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27
"}]
commands: ["kubectl label node <node> disktype=ssd --overwrite","kubectl taint node <node> dedicated=lab:NoSchedule","kubectl apply -f toleration-pod.yaml","kubectl describe pod tolerate-pod","kubectl taint node <node> dedicated=lab:NoSchedule-"]
expectedOutput: Pod scheduling behavior changes according to taints/tolerations/affinity rules.
troubleshooting: ["Pending pods: inspect Events for FailedScheduling reasons.","Remove test taints/labels after practice."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can apply/remove taints and labels.","I can explain why a Pod is Pending due to scheduling constraints."]

title: HPA and Self-Healing Observation
objective: Create an HPA and observe controller self-healing behavior.
objectiveMm: HPA ဖန်တီးခြင်းနှင့် self-healing behavior ကို လေ့လာခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Deployment with CPU requests set.
steps: ["Create a Deployment with resource requests.","Create an HPA targeting the Deployment.","Delete a Pod and observe automatic recreation by the controller."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"hpa-demo.yaml","content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-hpa-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-hpa-demo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-hpa-demo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-hpa-demo
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web-hpa-demo
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 4
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
"}]
commands: ["kubectl apply -f hpa-demo.yaml","kubectl get hpa","kubectl get pods -l app=web-hpa-demo","kubectl delete pod -l app=web-hpa-demo"]
expectedOutput: HPA object created; deleted pod replaced by Deployment controller.
troubleshooting: ["HPA may show unknown metrics if metrics-server is missing.","Self-healing still works via Deployment even without HPA scaling events."]
verificationChecklist: ["HPA created and inspectable.","Pod recreation observed after deletion."]

title: Service Types and Endpoints
objective: Expose a Deployment and verify service endpoints.
objectiveMm: Deployment ကို expose လုပ်ပြီး service endpoints များကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Cluster with working Pod networking.
steps: ["Deploy an app with labels.","Create ClusterIP/NodePort services and inspect endpoints/endpointslices.","Test connectivity from within the cluster."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"svc-demo.yaml","content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: echo
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: echo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: echo
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27

title: NetworkPolicy Allow/Deny Behavior
objective: Apply a NetworkPolicy and validate traffic restrictions.
objectiveMm: NetworkPolicy ကို အသုံးပြုပြီး traffic restrictions များကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Namespace with test client/server pods.
steps: ["Deploy server and client pods with labels.","Confirm baseline connectivity.","Apply restrictive NetworkPolicy and retest connectivity.","Add allow rule and verify permitted traffic."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"netpol-demo.yaml","content":"apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-allow-web
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: web
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
"}]
commands: ["kubectl get pods --show-labels","kubectl apply -f netpol-demo.yaml","kubectl describe netpol api-allow-web"]
expectedOutput: Traffic allowed/blocked according to policy (if enforced by CNI).
troubleshooting: ["If policy has no effect, CNI may not enforce NetworkPolicy.","Namespace selectors require correct labels on namespaces."]
verificationChecklist: ["Policy selects intended pods.","Observed behavior matches policy intent."]

title: Ingress and Gateway API Resource Inspection
objective: Create/inspect Ingress and review Gateway API resources.
objectiveMm: Ingress ကို ဖန်တီး/စစ်ဆေးခြင်းနှင့် Gateway API resources များကို လေ့လာခြင်း။

verificationChecklist: ["I can author a basic Ingress manifest.","I can identify Gateway API resource types and purpose."]

objective: Identify networking components and trace service-to-pod mapping.
objectiveMm: Networking components များကို ဖော်ထုတ်ပြီး service-to-pod mapping ကို ခြေရာခံခြင်း။

title: PVC Mount in a Pod
objective: Create and mount a PVC for persistent data.
objectiveMm: Persistent data အတွက် PVC ကို ဖန်တီး mount လုပ်ခြင်း။
prerequisites: ["Cluster with default StorageClass or pre-created PV","kubectl access"]
environmentSetup: Namespace with storage support.
steps: ["Create a PVC and wait for binding (if dynamic provisioning available).","Create a Pod mounting the PVC and write test data.","Restart/recreate Pod and verify data persistence (depending on backend)."]
yamlManifests:
[{"name":"pvc-pod.yaml","content":"apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: data-pvc
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pvc-demo
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /data
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: data-pvc
"}]
commands: ["kubectl apply -f pvc-pod.yaml","kubectl get pvc,pv,pod","kubectl exec pvc-demo -- sh -c 'echo hello > /data/test.txt'","kubectl exec pvc-demo -- cat /data/test.txt"]
expectedOutput: PVC binds and mounted volume is writable/readable in Pod.
troubleshooting: ["Pending PVC: check StorageClass, provisioner, events, and access mode compatibility.","Pod Pending: check volume attachment/mount events."]

title: StorageClass and Provisioning Behavior
objective: Inspect StorageClasses and understand dynamic provisioning settings.
objectiveMm: StorageClasses နှင့် dynamic provisioning settings များကို စစ်ဆေးနားလည်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Cluster with at least one StorageClass (most local clusters provide one).
steps: ["List StorageClasses and identify default class.","Describe provisioner, reclaimPolicy, and volumeBindingMode.","Create a PVC using a specific StorageClass and observe binding behavior."]
commands: ["kubectl get storageclass","kubectl describe storageclass <name>","kubectl get pvc -A"]
expectedOutput: StorageClass properties understood; PVC binding behavior observed.
troubleshooting: ["WaitForFirstConsumer delays binding until a Pod uses the PVC."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can identify default StorageClass.","I can explain reclaimPolicy and access modes."]

title: Diagnose PVC/PV and Mount Issues
objective: Use events and describe output to troubleshoot storage problems.
objectiveMm: Storage ပြဿနာများကို events/describe output များဖြင့် troubleshoot လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Use an intentionally misconfigured PVC/Pod in a lab namespace.
steps: ["Create a PVC requesting unavailable class/size/mode (lab scenario).","Observe Pending state and inspect events/describe output.","Correct the manifest and verify successful binding/mount."]
commands: ["kubectl get pvc,pv,pods","kubectl describe pvc <name>","kubectl describe pod <name>","kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp"]
expectedOutput: Root cause identified from events and resolved by configuration fix.
troubleshooting: ["Common causes: missing StorageClass, no matching PV, access mode mismatch, node affinity constraints."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can identify why PVC/Pod is Pending.","I can validate fix through status/events."]

title: Node Troubleshooting Workflow
objective: Practice systematic node triage using kubectl and node-level checks.
objectiveMm: Node ပြဿနာများကို စနစ်တကျ triage လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Lab cluster where a node issue can be simulated or reviewed.
steps: ["Check node statuses and conditions.","Inspect events and workloads affected by node issues.","Review kubelet/service indicators and propose remediation steps."]
commands: ["kubectl get nodes","kubectl describe node <node>","kubectl get pods -A -o wide","kubectl get events -A --sort-by=.lastTimestamp"]
expectedOutput: Likely failure domain identified (kubelet, runtime, network, pressure, etc.).
troubleshooting: ["Distinguish control-plane vs worker symptoms.","Drain/cordon considerations depend on workload state."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can gather evidence for node issues.","I can propose/execute safe remediation steps."]

objective: Debug common Pod failures and inspect control plane component health.
objectiveMm: Pod failures နှင့် control plane component health များကို debug လုပ်ခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Namespace with sample broken manifests (image typo, bad command, bad config).
steps: ["Deploy a broken Pod/Deployment and identify failure reason.","Use describe, logs, previous logs, and events to pinpoint root cause.","Fix manifest and verify recovery; inspect kube-system control plane pods for health signals."]

title: Service and DNS Troubleshooting
objective: Trace and fix Service/DNS connectivity issues.
objectiveMm: Service/DNS connectivity ပြဿနာများကို ခြေရာခံဖြေရှင်းခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Namespace with app and test client pod.
steps: ["Create a Service with an intentional selector mismatch and observe empty endpoints.","Fix selector/labels and verify endpoints populate.","Test DNS/name resolution and HTTP connectivity from a client pod."]
commands: ["kubectl get svc,endpointslices,pods --show-labels","kubectl describe svc <svc>","kubectl run test --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 --restart=Never -- nslookup <svc>","kubectl run test --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 --restart=Never -- wget -qO- http://<svc>"]
expectedOutput: Service endpoints become healthy and DNS/connectivity tests succeed after fix.
troubleshooting: ["Check targetPort/containerPort alignment.","NetworkPolicies may block test traffic."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can debug selector/endpoint issues.","I can validate DNS and service connectivity."]

title: Logs, Events, and kubectl top
objective: Collect observability signals for troubleshooting and monitoring.
objectiveMm: Troubleshooting/monitoring အတွက် logs, events, metrics signals များကို စုဆောင်းခြင်း။
environmentSetup: Running workloads generating logs.
steps: ["Stream and filter container logs (including previous logs if restarted).","List and sort events by timestamp.","Use kubectl top to inspect node/pod resource usage when available."]
commands: ["kubectl logs <pod> -n <ns>","kubectl logs <pod> -n <ns> --previous","kubectl get events -A --sort-by=.lastTimestamp","kubectl top nodes","kubectl top pods -A"]
expectedOutput: Relevant logs/events/metrics identified for a given issue.
troubleshooting: ["If kubectl top fails, metrics-server may not be installed.","Multi-container pods require -c <container>."]
verificationChecklist: ["I can retrieve current and previous logs.","I can correlate events with resource symptoms."]
